title: AMX AccountEvent (switch event)
description: AMA -> AMS immediate account event (docs/AMX-DESIGN.md §6.5). Pushed as soon as it is detected, independent of the 5-minute report cadence. Detection is dual (§6.4): comparing `tsamx status --json` around each `tsamx auto --once` tick, plus fsnotify on autoswitch_state.json. While AMS is unreachable, events queue in the encrypted outbox and are flushed on reconnect, deduplicated by eventId. JSON mirror of amx.v1.AccountEvent in contracts/proto/amx.proto.

eventId.description: Outbox dedupe key. AMS MUST ignore a repeated eventId — offline flush can resend.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened locally, not when it was transmitted (they differ after an offline queue flush).

kind.description: switch = active credential changed; quarantine = tsamx isolated an account; all_exhausted = every account is at or above the threshold; credential_unusable = the active account's on-disk credential carries no token material, so the §5.7 re-sync push was dropped (edge-triggered, once per incident; the account rides in `from`).

trigger.description: at-limit = utilization crossed the 95% threshold (D10); manual = AMS SwitchNow; failover = previous account failed.

from.description: Account that was active before. Absent on the first activation and on all_exhausted. Identified by email alone — a quarantine detected from tsamx state may not carry the AMS id.

to.description: Account that became active. Absent on quarantine and all_exhausted.

detail.description: Human-readable context for the audit trail. MUST NOT contain credential material (§7).
